subject: Unable to get data from different folders using reactiveFileReader

messages.author: 81349c82fb5ee906
messages.subject: Unable to get data from different folders using reactiveFileReader
parts:
Hi,

I am working on an  app (attached zip folder) where I have to take data from different folders. But I am unable to get the data. Please help me.

Structure
I have three folders named "A", "B", and "C". I have different .csv file, named data.csv, in these folders.

Problem
 I want to see the data present in these .csv data files.   

##########
ui.r 

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  # Application title
  titlePanel("Mydata"),

  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(inputId = "folder", label = "Select the folder to get the data", choices = c("A", "B", "C"))
    ),

    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      dataTableOutput(outputId = "dataDisplay")
    )
  )
))


##########
server.r 

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  data <- reactiveFileReader(intervalMillis = 1000, session, filePath = paste0(input$folder, "/data.csv"), readFunc = read.csv)

  output$dataDisplay <- renderDataTable({
    mydata <- data()
    mydata
  })

})

messages.author: af2b60295205d4cb
messages.subject: Re: Unable to get data from different folders using reactiveFileReader
parts:
Hi Saurabh,

Here's a solution to your issue (at least it worked for me). For ui.R make sure to have a "selected" argument, so there's a default. For server.R, wrap your paste0() inside a "reactive({})" function

#ui.R

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  # Application title
  titlePanel("Mydata"),

  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
selectInput(inputId = "folder", label = "Select the folder to get the data", choices = c("A", "B", "C"), selected = "A")

),

    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(

tableOutput(outputId = "dataDisplay")
    )
  )
))


#server.R
library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  file <- reactive({paste0(input$folder, "/data.csv")})
  data <- reactiveFileReader(intervalMillis = 1000, session, filePath = file, readFunc = read.csv)
 
 output$dataDisplay <- renderTable({
   data()
   
  })

})


Let me know you have any questions.
